Carbon dioxide

Plants make food from sunlight, water, and carbon dioxide. This process is called photosynthesis, and it happens in the leaves. The plant stores the food as sugar and releases oxygen into the air. Learners can watch this by placing a leaf in the sun and noticing that it stays green where light reaches it. Plants make food from sunlight, water, and carbon dioxide.
